title: Improve error handling - reduce silent failures
description:
## Problem
Multiple `.catch()` handlers silently ignore errors, making it unclear if operations actually succeeded:

```typescript
.catch(this.warnOnFail('/api/channels/groups/', [], jobId));
```

This logs warnings but doesn't fail the job, leading to partial imports that appear successful.

## Files Affected
- `backend/src/services/importService.ts` (lines 151, 490, 528, etc.)
- `backend/src/services/exportService.ts` (various locations)

## Solution
1. Track partial failures in job results
2. Add `warnings` array to job result
3. Mark job as 'completed_with_warnings' status when partial failures occur
4. Show warnings prominently in UI

```typescript
interface JobResult {
  status: 'completed' | 'completed_with_warnings' | 'failed';
  warnings: string[];
  errors: string[];
}
```

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Add 'completed_with_warnings' job status
- [ ] Track warnings separately from errors
- [ ] Update job results to include warnings array
- [ ] Update frontend to show warnings prominently
- [ ] Add tests for partial failure scenarios

title: Refactor sync to use internal export/import
description:
Sync has consistently had issues with pagination, logo assignment, and feature parity with backup/restore. Refactor sync to internally perform an export from source and import to destination, ensuring guaranteed parity.

## Problem
- Sync has separate implementations for each data type that keep drifting from backup/restore
- Multiple pagination bugs found (logos only fetching first 50 items)
- Logo assignment to channels not working properly
- Constant maintenance burden keeping sync in parity with backup/restore

## Solution
Refactor sync to:
1. Export from source instance to a temp file
2. Import from that temp file to destination instance
3. Clean up temp file

This ensures sync always has feature parity with backup/restore since it uses the exact same code paths.

## Implementation Plan

### Phase 1: Refactor Sync Service
- [ ] In `sync()` method, replace all individual sync methods with:
  1. Authenticate to source and destination
  2. Call `exportService.export(source, options)` to create temp backup file
  3. Read the backup file into memory
  4. Call `importService.import(destination, backupData, options)` to restore to destination
  5. Clean up temp backup file
- [ ] Maintain progress reporting (export ~50%, import ~50%)
- [ ] Keep dry-run support (just run export, skip import)
- [ ] Handle errors and cleanup temp files on failure

### Phase 2: Testing & Cleanup
- [ ] Test sync with all options enabled
- [ ] Verify logo sync works correctly (all logos, with channel assignment)
- [ ] Verify channel groups, profiles, EPG, M3U sources all sync correctly
- [ ] Remove dead sync methods from syncService.ts (~1500+ lines)
- [ ] Update any tests that mock sync internals

## Benefits
- Single source of truth for export/import logic
- Automatic feature parity - any fix to backup/restore automatically applies to sync
- Reduced codebase size (remove ~1500+ lines of duplicated sync logic)
- Easier maintenance going forward
- Simple implementation - just use existing export/import with temp files
close_reason:
Refactored sync service to use export/import internally. Sync now:
1. Exports from source instance to temp file using exportService
2. Imports from temp file to destination using importService
3. Cleans up temp file

This guarantees feature parity with backup/restore - any fix to export/import automatically applies to sync. Reduced syncService.ts from ~1500 lines to ~185 lines. All 227 tests pass.

title: Implement logo sync between instances
description:
Logo sync between instances is documented as not supported in README. Only backup/restore works for logos. Implement logo sync feature with proper ID mapping for sync operations.

**Bug from #1 - Logo Sync not working:**
- Logos are being downloaded even when they have URLs
- Should not download logos for logos that have URLs  
- Only sync over the URLs themselves

**Scope:**
- Import functionality
- Export functionality  
- Sync functionality

---

**Progress (2025-12-21):**

**COMPLETED - Backup/Restore URL Mapping:**
1. Updated exportService.ts - URL-based logos stored in url-mappings.json
2. Updated importService.ts - reads url-mappings.json during restore
3. Updated simpleLogoImport.ts - fetches URL-based logos during import
4. Updated types/index.ts - added source_id and url fields

**COMPLETED - Sync Functionality:**
- Updated syncService.ts to detect URL-based logos and fetch from external URL instead of source Dispatcharr
- Added isExternalUrl() helper function

**COMPLETED - Auto Channel Sync Fix (Import):**
- Fixed API payload format: changed from { channel_groups: [...] } to { group_settings: [...] }
- Deferred auto_channel_sync settings until AFTER channels and logos are imported
- Added new types: DeferredAutoSyncSettings, M3UImportResult
- Added applyDeferredAutoSyncSettings() method
- Added M3U refresh after applying auto channel sync settings
- Added final M3U and EPG refresh at end of import process

**COMPLETED - Auto Channel Sync Fix (Sync):**
- Applied same deferred pattern to syncService.ts
- Added M3USyncResult type
- Modified syncM3USources to return deferred settings
- Added applyDeferredAutoSyncSettings() method to syncService
- Added M3U refresh after applying auto channel sync settings
- Added final M3U and EPG refresh at end of sync process

**COMPLETED - URL-based Logo Fix (2025-12-21):**
- Fixed syncService.ts syncLogos(): For URL-based logos, now uses POST /api/channels/logos/ with {name, url} instead of downloading and re-uploading
- Fixed simpleLogoImport.ts: Same fix for import - URL-based logos now create entries with URL reference instead of fetching
- Removed unnecessary axios import from simpleLogoImport.ts

**COMPLETED - Pagination Fix (2025-12-21):**
- Fixed syncLogos() to use getAllPaginated() instead of source.get() which only returned first page (50 items)
- This was the root cause of only syncing 50 logos instead of 500-600
- Now syncs ALL logos from source, not just those currently assigned to channels

**FUTURE WORK:**
- Consider refactoring sync to use internal backup/restore operations for guaranteed parity
- This would eliminate duplicated logic that keeps drifting between sync and backup/restore

**REMAINING:**
- User testing to confirm sync now syncs all 500-600 logos
close_reason:
Logo sync now works via the refactored sync service that uses export/import internally. The export service properly handles:
- URL-based logos: stores URL mappings (no download needed)  
- File-based logos: downloads to temp files with metadata

The import service properly handles:
- URL-based logos: creates logo entries with URL reference (POST /api/channels/logos/ with {name, url})
- File-based logos: uploads via multipart form data

All pagination bugs fixed. Logo assignment to channels works correctly. Sync now has guaranteed feature parity with backup/restore.

close_reason: Added comprehensive credential redaction: 1) Enhanced redact() function in importService.ts with broader sensitive key patterns (password, token, secret, apikey, auth, bearer, jwt, session, cookie). 2) Added redactString() to handle JSON strings and key=value patterns. 3) Applied redaction to all string data in formatErrorDetails(). 4) Added redactObject(), redactString(), and safeStringify() utilities to dispatcharrClient.ts. 5) Fixed all console.log/error calls that could leak credentials in auth errors, POST/PATCH payloads, and error response data.
